theme: lease SLA age PARSEISO + TIMEDIFF + PARSEMS gate

tests.name: open_pin_now
tests.cmd: open → LEASE FROMTIME TIME ISO Z

tests.name: pin_y2k_age_deny
tests.cmd: pin 2000-01-01Z; gate soft deny + REQUIRE rc2

tests.name: offset_ignored
tests.cmd: +01:00 pin → …01:00Z; span vs Z midnight −3600 not 0

weaknesses.title: PARSEISO ignores timezone offsets (+01:00 / -05:00)
weaknesses.detail: Wall time treated as UTC. 2000-01-01T01:00:00+01:00 → epoch of 01:00Z (946688400) not 00:00Z. Offset-aware stamps silently wrong by hours; pin canonicalizes to wrong Z.

weaknesses.title: LOCAL stamps reparsed as UTC — TZ skew
weaknesses.detail: SYS LOCAL yields no Z; PARSEISO treats as UTC. On UTC+3 host LOCAL now is ~+10800s vs TIME. Agents that pin LOCAL and age via TIMEDIFF get wrong ages.
weaknesses.repro: LOCAL; PARSEISO LAST vs TIME → delta = TZ hours

weaknesses.title: HUMANMS multi-unit age labels not PARSEMS-round-trippable
weaknesses.detail: Age of Y2K → 1387w6d14m28s via HUMANMS; PARSEMS cannot reparse compound labels. SLA configs must stay single-unit.

weaknesses.title: TIMEDIFF whole-second only — sub-second lease SLA imprecise
weaknesses.detail: Age resolution is 1s. Leases with 500ms SLA cannot distinguish. No MS-epoch TIMEDIFF dual.
weaknesses.repro: open; age immediately → 0 even if 900ms elapsed

weaknesses.title: Fractional seconds truncated without flag
weaknesses.detail: …T00:12:10.999Z and …T00:12:10Z same epoch. No PARSEISO_MS / subsecond retain.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: LEASE/SLA/AGE cat -A glue; od shows no \n.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE softens
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_LA_REQUIRE=abc → REQUIRE_HIT stays 0; hard paths soft-pass.

weaknesses.title: No ABS/clamp helper for negative ages
weaknesses.detail: Future stamps yield negative TIMEDIFF; agents hand-clamp for gate. No SYS ABS or AGECLAMP.

workarounds: Always pin UTC Z via FROMTIME TIME; never store bare LOCAL
Reject or strip offsets before PARSEISO; require trailing Z
Store SLA as integer ms not multi-unit human labels
Whole-second SLAs only; ignore sub-second remain
Digit-check REQUIRE; CLEAR_ERR after soft PARSEISO
language_gaps: PARSEISO LOCAL / timezone-aware dual of FROMTIME
MS-resolution TIMEDIFF or epoch_ms clock pair
PARSEMS multi-unit compound matching HUMANMS output
